Question Choices: A board game turn cycle lasts 5 days. If you take your first turn on a Monday (Day 1 of a 7-day week), what day of the week will your 4th turn fall on?
Hints: The 4th turn is 3 turns after the first;Add 3 × 5 days and reduce mod 7
Solution: Three additional turns at 5 days each adds 15 days. 15 ≡ 1 (mod 7), so Day 1 + 1 = Day 2, which is Tuesday.

A small gear with 12 teeth drives a larger gear with 30 teeth. How many full rotations must the small gear complete before both gears return to their exact starting alignment?
Solution: LCM(12, 30) = 60 teeth must pass. For the 12-tooth gear that is 60 ÷ 12 = 5 full rotations.

A traffic light stays Green for 45 seconds, Yellow for 5 seconds, and Red for 30 seconds (an 80-second full cycle). If the light turns Green at exactly 12:00:00 PM, what color will it be 12 minutes and 30 seconds later?
Solution: 12 minutes 30 seconds = 750 seconds. 750 mod 80 = 30, and 30 seconds into the cycle is still within the first 45 seconds, so the light is Green.
